sloka: ऊर्ध्व बाहुः पंच तपा मास आहारो जितेइन्द्रियः ।तस्य वर्ष सहस्राणि घोरे तपसि तिष्ठतः ॥१-४२-१३॥
transliteration: ūrdhva bāhuḥ paṁca tapā māsa āhāro jiteindriyaḥ ।tasya varṣa sahasrāṇi ghore tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ ॥1-42-13॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed, (Rama) Bhagiratha continued in that state for a thousand years amidst rigid austerities. Lord of all creatures, Brahma was highly pleased with that illustrious king.
